Class SoftOffers

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.SoftOffers
public final class SoftOffers extends Object
The rules about soft offers (issue #483): the optional, ULA-only step after hiring decisions are released in which each assigned applicant is asked whether to proceed to a formal offer. One place, like HiringDecisions, so the release endpoint (issue #485), the applicant's soft offer (issue #486) and the results page (issue #487) agree.
